[LSIG.1.3.1] `active_fraction` computes the time-weighted fraction of the
sliding window during which the slot held `true`:

$\mathit{active\_fraction}([t-W, t]) = \frac{1}{W}\int_{t-W}^{t} b(\tau)\,d\tau,\qquad b(\tau) \in \{0, 1\}$

where `b(τ)` is the slot's value as a piecewise-constant step function
(each asserted value held until the next assertion). Before the slot's first
absorption `b(τ)` is `0`: the integral counts that time as not `true`, and the
slot holds no `false` then ([LSIG.1.4.1]).
